text: For this child I prayed, and the LORD has granted me my petition that I made to him.
There is none holy like the LORD: for there is none besides you; there is no rock like our God.
Till now the LORD has helped us.
Behold, you are old and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint for us a king to judge us like all the nations.
Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen? There is none like him among all the people.
Only fear the LORD and serve him faithfully with all your heart. For consider what great things he has done for you.

But now your kingdom shall not continue. The LORD has sought out a man after his own heart, and the LORD has commanded him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept what the LORD commanded you.
I have sinned, for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
Do not look on his appearance or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him. For the LORD sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart.
You come to me with a sword and with a spear and with a javelin, but I come to you in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
Go in peace, because we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, 'The LORD shall be between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.'
The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD's anointed, to put out my hand against him, seeing he is the LORD's anointed.
On me alone, my lord, be the guilt. Please let your servant speak in your ears, and hear the words of your servant.
Do not destroy him, for who can put out his hand against the LORD's anointed and be guiltless?
Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?
Pursue, for you shall surely overtake and shall surely rescue.
